item.title: Remove the History Button on Black Highlighter?
item.content:encoded:
Is there any way to remove the history button on Black Highlighter with css?
(This is for the art exchange)

EDIT: Nevermind it's:

 [[module CSS]] a#history-button, a#files-button { display: none !important; } [[/module]]
